execution.progress: repeat counts complete operations. Ongoing operations continue with the same resolved identities. abilities.name: Portable insulation

abilities.costs: Craft: 4 actual owned bark + 2 vine, 5 stationary rounds at 1.5 energy. abilities.effects: One real 2.2-mass mantle, initially unequipped. Condition 160, loses 1 per equipped round. Moisture rises 0.10 in exposed rain, falls 0.02 otherwise.
